newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KYM Holdings in rights, special issues.
newsitem.headline: KYM Holdings in rights, special issues.

text.p: KYM Holdings Bhd said it is proposing a rights issue and special issue of shares to raise 200.83 million ringgit.

In a statement sent on Tuesday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the paper bag maker said the funds would be used to repay bank borrowings, for capital spending, working capital and to defray expenses related to the proposed issues.

It is planning a rights issue of up to 60.04 million new shares at 3.00 ringgit per share on a three-for-two basis and a special issue of 6.9 million new shares at 3.00 ringgit a piece to Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) investors approved by the Ministry of International Trade and Industry.

Part of the proceeds will be used to pay for the company's diversification into property development, through the purchase of equity in Tegas Consolidated Sdn Bhd. Tegas, now 90 percent owned by KYM, owns beachfront property in nothern Perak state.

KYM has also bought all shares of Technology Resources Development Sdn Bhd, which is developing mixed residential and commercial properties, and has a 21.9 percent stake in Juan Kuang (M) Industrial Bhd, which makes automotive wiring harnesses and other electrical products.
